fdroid:com.leadaxe.lxbox.name: L×Box: VPN & Proxy Client
fdroid:com.leadaxe.lxbox.summary: VPN client: 12+ protocols, subscriptions, app routing, balancing, traffic stats
fdroid:com.leadaxe.lxbox.description:
L×Box is a high-performance proxy client with no compromises.
You choose the servers. You set the rules. You control the traffic. L×Box does exactly what you told it to.
12+ protocols, your Tailscale network, advanced routing, full DNS control, detour chains, per-app split tunneling and built-in diagnostics.
THE CORE IS OURS
L×Box runs on sing-box-lx, our own fork of sing-box, developed together with the app. On top of stock sing-box the core adds:
• AmneziaWG 3.1 — obfuscated WireGuard;
• XHTTP — Xray transport, including stream-one;
• VLESS + ML-KEM-768 — post-quantum protection;
• MASQUE — Cloudflare WARP as a full node and a chain link.
And it is tuned for real life on a phone:
• DNS groups — several resolvers with failover;
• smart urltest — pools, sticky selection, lazy health checks;
• load balancing — connections spread across the pool;
• self-healing of stuck connections;
• idle tunnel sleep — less memory, less battery;
• observability — DNS, connections and chains visible from the app.
12+ PROTOCOLS
VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC v5, NaiveProxy, AnyTLS, SSH, SOCKS, WireGuard, Tailscale, AmneziaWG 3.1, MASQUE over QUIC/HTTP-3.
Cloudflare WARP in one tap: simple registration right in the app, the private key is generated on your device and never leaves it — Cloudflare receives only the public half. WireGuard or MASQUE.
Import any familiar format: subscriptions and links, Base64, Xray arrays, WireGuard URI/INI, Amnezia vpn://, sing-box JSON configs, local files, plain text.
TAILSCALE WITHOUT A SECOND APP
Android runs one VPN at a time, so a Tailscale app and a proxy client cannot run together. In L×Box the Tailscale node runs inside the core: the phone joins your tailnet, and the rest of the traffic follows your rules.
• devices answer by name through MagicDNS;
• exit to the internet through an exit node of your tailnet;
• sign-in, device list and ping with the path in the app;
• your own control server is supported.
SUBSCRIPTIONS WITHOUT MANUAL WORK
Add a subscription — L×Box parses it and creates nodes with no duplicates. Unwanted nodes can be switched off and stay off through every update, even if the provider renames them.
Processing rules with regex and capture groups rename, rewrite or disable nodes on every refresh — and show in advance which nodes a rule will hit.
ROUTING YOU ACTUALLY CONTROL
One device can host several environments at once: work, home, travel. Each with its own rules and its own route.
Conditions: domain, IP and CIDR, port, protocol, app, network type.
DNS UNDER YOUR CONTROL
Several resolvers at once. A separate DNS per rule. FakeIP.
FULL DIAGNOSTICS ON BOARD
Ping and speed-test a node, a folder or the whole subscription — with the tunnel up or down. One-way connections get flagged. Full log right in the app. In real time the built-in tools show: which app opened a connection, where to, how much it transferred, which DNS it used, which route it took. Speed and traffic per app and per connection.
AUTOMATION
Works with automation tools (such as Tasker or MacroDroid): start, stop, switch node, query state. Your phone reshapes the setup to your scenarios — at home, on the road, when Wi-Fi changes.
WE SEND YOUR DATA NOWHERE
No account. No ads, no analytics, no advertising ID, no crash reporters. L×Box connects only to the servers and update endpoints you configured. Full backup and restore moves your setup to a new device.
A CLIENT, NOT A VPN SERVICE
L×Box provides no servers and sells no access to anyone's network — you choose your servers and subscriptions.
L×Box is a professional tool for network security, routing and network health checks. Use is allowed only in strict compliance with the laws of the country where the tool is used. Full responsibility for compliance lies with the user.
OPEN SOURCE
Free software under GPLv3. English and Russian UI, light and dark themes.
GitHub: github.com/Leadaxe/LxBox

flathub:io.github.fabiangreffrath.Doom.description:
Crispy Doom is a conservative, historically-accurate Doom source port, which is compatible with
 the thousands of mods and levels that were made before the Doom source code was released. Unlike
 other source ports, the goal is to preserve the original look, feel, limitations, and bugs of the
 original DOS executable.
 Full support for single- and multi-player games is provided, for all of the original Doom games,
 Chex Quest, and Hacx. Unlike the original executable, network play is implemented on the IP network
 stack, allowing it to function on modern LANs and the Internet.
 The easiest way to run Crispy Doom is to copy a supported game file (known as a "WAD") to the
 root of your home directory and launch the application. If you have trouble with the automatic
 game file detection or need to manage multiple WAD files, you can run the application from the
 command line with a path to the selected game file:
 flatpak run io.github.fabiangreffrath.Doom -iwad ~/PATH/TO/GAME.WAD

fedora-packages:chunkfs/chunkfs.description: ChunkFS is a FUSE based filesystem that allows you to mount an arbitrary file or block device as a directory tree of files that each represent a chunk of user-specified size of the mounted file. The chunk size is global per mount, but at mount time any value can be specified. (If the file size isn't a multiple of the specified chunk size, the last file in the tree simply will be smaller than the chunk size.) Only read access is supported at the moment. UnChunkFS is the inversion of ChunkFS—it allows you to mount a ChunkFS tree (or a copy of it, of course), and gives you a single file named image that has the same contents as the file or device you created the tree from by mounting it as a ChunkFS.

firefox-addons:2939877.description:
Privacy Toggles – Protezione privacy 
Privacy Toggles ti permette di gestire in modo semplice e immediato le principali funzioni di privacy di Firefox.

🔹 Funzionalità principali:
 Anti-Fingerprinting (RFP): riduce la possibilità di identificazione tramite fingerprint unici del browser.
 First-Party Isolation: separa i cookie per dominio, impedendo correlazioni tra siti diversi.
 Tracking Protection avanzata: blocca tracker noti e cookie di terze parti.
 Referrer disabilitati: impedisce l’invio automatico dell’URL di provenienza.
 Hyperlink Auditing (ping) off: blocca i “ping” che tracciano i click.
 Predict/Prefetch off: disattiva caricamenti preventivi non richiesti.
 WebRTC bloccato: evita possibili leak dell’IP reale.
 URL Cleaner: rimuove in automatico parametri di tracciamento (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, ecc.) dai link.

firefox-addons:3029364.description:
O que a extensão faz?
Aplica um efeito de desfoque sobre o conteúdo do WhatsApp Web. Para revelar qualquer elemento, basta passar o cursor do mouse sobre ele. É possível ativar e desativar todos os efeitos de uma vez com o atalho Alt+Shift+B ou pelo botão na barra de ferramentas do navegador.
Cada elemento pode ser controlado individualmente:
Texto das mensagens — borra o conteúdo das conversas abertas
Mídia — borra imagens, vídeos e stickers de forma independente
Nomes de contatos — borra os nomes na lista lateral de conversas
Preview de mensagens — borra o texto da última mensagem na lateral
Fotos de perfil — borra todos os avatares
Esta extensão não coleta absolutamente nenhum dado, e aqui está a prova:
A extensão não faz nenhuma requisição de rede. Ela não possui servidores, não se comunica com endereços externos e não envia nada para lugar nenhum. Você pode verificar isso abrindo as ferramentas de desenvolvedor do Firefox (F12 → aba Rede) enquanto a extensão está ativa: não aparecerá nenhuma requisição originada por ela.
As únicas informações armazenadas são suas preferências de configuração (quais elementos você escolheu borrar), e elas ficam salvas exclusivamente no armazenamento local do seu próprio navegador, usando a API padrão browser.storage.local. Esses dados nunca saem do seu computador, não são sincronizados com nenhum servidor e são apagados automaticamente se você desinstalar a extensão.
A extensão não lê, não processa e não tem acesso ao conteúdo das suas mensagens. Ela funciona aplicando classes CSS diretamente nos elementos visuais da página — o mesmo princípio de mudar a cor de um botão. Nenhum texto, imagem ou dado de conversa é capturado ou interpretado pelo código.
Resumo de segurança:
 Sem conexões externas
 Sem rastreamento ou analytics
 Sem acesso ao conteúdo das mensagens
 Configurações salvas apenas localmente no seu navegador

firefox-addons:15095.description:
Important announcement 
With Firefox Version 57 (Nov. 2017) the classic add-on support will be dropped. Only Web-Extensions will be allowed. As a result, some features will be lost and some will be crippled. Version 5 has (again) been heavily rewritten to work as web-extension.
 About the add-on 
The add-on uses dict.cc to translate words and phrases in any website, epub or pdf.
No add-on is faster, easier or more precise!
- Text selection is only required for phrases.
- Use rocker gestures or modifiers (for example ctrl+alt) and mouseclick to quickly translate the word under your cursor.
- Use the context menu to get more options.
- Quick search via toolbar button or Alt+Q shortcut.
- This is a word and phrase translation, it does not translate whole sentences.
- I'm not the author or owner of dict.cc , I just wrote this Firefox add-on.
All languages from dict.cc are supported, and if new ones arrive, you can just update the list of languages from within the add-on.
And now it's also possible to do a quick search using a combination of [ctrl,shift,alt] + click on a word.
Results can be shown as a pop-up or in a new tab or as an in-page translation layer.
 About dict.cc 
 dict.cc is a nice dictionary with mostly German English translations, but other languages are also available and growing. dict.cc shows quite a lot of different possible results, instead of just one, so you have a better chance of finding the correct one.
 Help 
If you have problems, questions or other feedback, please create an issue on GitHub.
If you like it, please write a review.
I've received suggestions on how to improve the add-on, which can't be done without changes on dict.cc (The website):

firefox-addons:3070491.name: Auto-Cart Shopping Assistant
firefox-addons:3070491.summary: Adds items from a shopping list to your cart on Mercadona, Bonpreu/Esclat, and Día. Never completes checkout.
firefox-addons:3070491.description:
Paste your weekly shopping list, one item per line, with as much or as
little detail as you want — quantities, brand preferences, size ranges,
dietary notes ("no added sugar", "sin gluten") — and the assistant searches
each store, picks the best-matching product for every line, and adds it to
your cart. You always place the order yourself; the extension never
completes a purchase. 
Doing the same weekly supermarket order by hand — searching the same 20-30
items, picking the right pack size, adding each to cart — is repetitive.
This extension automates the tedious middle part (search → match → add) and
leaves the part that should stay a deliberate human decision (reviewing the
cart and paying) exactly where it belongs: with you, on the store's own
site.
 Plain-text shopping lists. Write your list the way you'd write it for
 yourself — 2x Yogur natural , Salmón congelado (sin piel, 250-500 g) ,
 # meat section as a comment to organize the list. Bullets ( - , * ,
 1. ), blank lines, and # comment lines are all handled automatically.
 Fuzzy, constraint-aware matching. Weight/size ranges and simple
 keyword constraints ("no added sugar", "sin gluten") are matched directly
 against each store's product data — including correctly distinguishing
 "250-500 g" for one yogurt from "250-500 g" for a whole multi-pack.
 AI disambiguation, only when genuinely needed. Most items resolve with
 plain rule-based matching. When a search returns several similarly-good
 candidates, one batched request (using your own Anthropic API key)
 disambiguates them using the item's own notes and any general shopping
 preferences you've set — never a per-item AI call.
 General shopping preferences. A separate notes field ("prefer the
 cheapest equivalent", "avoid products with additives") applies to every
 item in the run, not just one line.
 Multi-store in one run. Mercadona, Bonpreu/Esclat, and Día side by
 side — pick which stores to run against each time.
 Optional cart clearing. Empty each store's existing cart before adding
 your list, for a clean weekly re-run — using each store's own native
 "empty cart" mechanism, not slow one-by-one removal.
 Live progress and a clear results table. Every item's outcome is
 reported — added (with the actual product and price that landed in your
 cart), needs manual review, or failed — with the reason, so nothing
 silently disappears. Progress is also mirrored in the browser tab's
 title, so you can check how a run is going while browsing another tab.
 Cross-store comparison. Running against two or more stores in one go
 adds one extra, automatic summary at the end pointing out where the two
 carts differ — a cheaper match at one store, or an item that only one
 store's search could find.
 Daily health checks. A background check flags a red badge on the
 toolbar icon if a store's search stops working, so you find out before
 you start shopping, not partway through.
 Runs in your own logged-in session. No separate login, no credential
 storage — the extension acts inside your existing, already-logged-in
 browser tabs for each store.
 Open the extension (toolbar icon) and paste your list.
 Pick which stores to run against, and optionally check "Empty each
 store's cart first."
 Hit Run. The assistant opens a background tab per store if needed,
 searches for each item, filters by your constraints, and adds matches to
 cart — asking an AI model to pick between close candidates only when the
 rule-based match is genuinely ambiguous.
 If you ran 2+ stores, a short AI-written comparison appears once
 everything's done, calling out anything worth a second look between the
 carts.
 Review the results table, switch to each store's tab, and check out
 yourself whenever you're ready.
 The extension never completes checkout or handles payment. It only
 ever searches for products and adds them to cart — the final review and
 purchase step is always yours, on the store's own site.
 No data is collected by, or sent to, this extension's developer. 
 There is no backend server owned by this project. All persistent data
 (your list text, store selection, preferences, and a small cache of past
 item→product matches) is stored locally via the browser's own
 storage.local / storage.sync , the same mechanism any extension uses to
 remember its settings.
 AI disambiguation is opt-in and limited. If you set an Anthropic API
 key in the extension's settings, the item text and a short list of
 candidate product names/prices/sizes are sent directly from your browser
 to Anthropic's API for genuinely ambiguous items only — never for every
 item, and never to any server other than Anthropic's own API. Leave the
 key blank and no data leaves your browser at all; ambiguous items are
 simply flagged for you to resolve by hand.
 The cross-store comparison uses the same key and the same direct
 browser→Anthropic connection. When 2+ stores are run, one extra request
 sends that run's own results — item names, the product name/price/size
 that landed in each cart, and any failure reasons — so the model can
 summarize where the stores diverged. No new information is gathered for this beyond what
 the run already produced, and it's skipped entirely (silently, not a
 failure) without an API key.
 No credentials are touched. The extension relies entirely on your
 existing, already-logged-in session in your own browser tabs. It never
 asks for, stores, or transmits a password, payment method, or other
 account credential for any store.
 Mercadona ( tienda.mercadona.es )
 Bonpreu / Esclat (compraonline.bonpreuesclat.cat)
 Día ( dia.es )
More Spanish supermarket chains may be added if they support a compatible
online cart. (Some chains — Lidl, at the time of writing — don't offer
online grocery ordering at all, only in-store pickup for non-food goods, and
so can't be supported.)

firefox-addons:3085562.name: Theme Studio for LeetCode
firefox-addons:3085562.summary: Custom LeetCode themes and dark mode for the code editor and problem page. Set any own picture or anime scene as your background + 7 other theme such as pixel, adventure, spider etc.
firefox-addons:3085562.description:
Give LeetCode a complete makeover. Theme Studio adds dark mode themes, a matching code editor theme with its own syntax colors, and a custom background image behind the problem page. Pick one of eight handcrafted LeetCode themes, or turn any picture into one: an anime wallpaper, a photo you love, your desk setup. Text stays readable on every background, because the contrast is calculated from your picture.
It restyles the whole page, not just the editor: the problem description, the code editor and its syntax highlighting, the testcase console, the panels, the top bar and the fonts. Themes switch instantly in every open tab with no reload, and Off gives you the default look back.
ANIME STUDIO
• 18 scenes included, from moonlit shrines to city nights and dragons. Or add your own picture.
• A scene for each difficulty: a calm train window for Easy, a moonlit shrine for Medium, a crimson dragon for Hard. Choose your own for each.
• Panels turn into frosted glass over the scene, and syntax colors are generated from the art, with every token type in its own color.
• Readable by design: the glass is solved for each scene so text always clears strong contrast. No setting can make your code unreadable.
• Episode title cards: open an unsolved problem and it plays like an episode, 「第1話」 with the title and the arc.
• Verdict moments with sound effects for Accepted, passed tests, Wrong Answer and Time Limit Exceeded.
SHARE YOUR ACCEPTED SUBMISSIONS AND STREAK
After an Accepted submission you get a card with the problem, difficulty, your Beats %, language, runtime and your daily solve streak, ready to post on LinkedIn or X in one click. You can turn it off anytime.
EIGHT THEMES
• Anime Studio: 18 scenes or your own picture.
• Vintage Paper: crumpled kraft paper on a walnut desk, a warm light look.
• Sakura Night: petal pink and cold cyan on plum indigo.
• Grid: a dark drafting table with hard edges and monospace type.
• Orchid: silk velvet with rose-gold trim.
• Web Crawler: charcoal webs, crimson and electric blue, with spiders that drop in on your verdicts.
• Adventure: an RPG night realm with quests and loot.
• Pixel Art: an 8-bit world. Submit an Accepted answer and a pixel gunner blasts the page to pieces, then rewinds it.
FOCUS MODE FOR CONTESTS AND INTERVIEWS
One shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+.) hides the scene, the animations and the sound, so you can practice for coding interviews and weekly contests without distraction.
FAST AND PRIVATE
• No lag: scrolling and typing were measured and match the stock site.
• Nothing animates while you type.
• No account, no sign-in, no analytics and no network requests. Your settings and pictures stay in your browser.
• Runs only on problem pages.
Found a bug or want a new theme? Use the Report bug button in the popup.
Some scene artwork designed by Freepik – Magnific.com .
Theme Studio for LeetCode is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by LeetCode.

apple-macos:6784363523.description:
Your money, clearly.
Moneys brings every account, every currency, your investments and your crypto together on iPhone, iPad and Mac. No bank connection, no account to create, no ads. Your ledger lives on your device and, if you like, in your own iCloud: it never passes through our servers.
Log expenses, income and transfers in seconds, let recurring transactions record themselves and watch your net worth take shape, at today's value.
Features
• Every account at its true value
Checking and savings accounts, cards, cash, loans and mortgages, each in its own currency and converted at the day's rates, with each currency's own precision: up to eight decimals for crypto. For every account, see what it's worth today and how much you've put in.
• Investments and crypto
Holdings with quantity and average cost; coins on exchanges and in wallets, with buys, sells, staking and airdrops, prices updated during the day and coin logos. Their value counts toward your net worth, while your ledger stays exactly what you paid in, to the cent.
• A ledger for real life
Transactions split across categories, recurring transactions you can pause, tags, notes, value dates and attachments: photos, scans and PDFs. Filter by amount, tag and merchant, search everything, browse the spending calendar and review possible duplicates.
• The whole picture
The Summary shows your net worth, assets and liabilities, the period's cash flow, your spending pace and the categories that weigh the most. At the end of the year, Your Year in Moneys tells the story of your twelve months.
• Budgets and goals
Monthly budgets by category or overall, with live progress, and savings goals that can follow an account's balance on their own.
• Reminders
A heads-up for upcoming recurring transactions and for the day before a card is charged.
• Widgets, Siri and Spotlight
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: balance, net worth, portfolio, budgets, upcoming transactions and a new transaction in one tap. Ask Siri to add an expense, make a transfer or tell you what you've spent; find transactions and accounts with Spotlight.
• iPad and Mac
Lists beside their details, Split View and Stage Manager, keyboard and trackpad with shortcuts. On the Mac, Moneys is a native app with every section in the sidebar.
• iCloud and backups
Automatic sync across your devices through your own iCloud, automatic backups to iCloud Drive, export to JSON or CSV, and a restore that always saves a safety copy first.
• Private by design
Face ID or Touch ID lock, no account, no tracking, no ads. Crypto prices arrive the same for everyone: no one learns which coins you hold.
• Beautiful and accessible
A new black-and-gold look, in light and dark, in 11 languages, with Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and subtle animations.
Moneys Plus
Unlimited accounts, currencies and categories, account folders, advanced insights and a month-end forecast, budgets and goals, annualized returns and investment charts, each coin's history and gain, CSV import from your bank, PDF reports, interactive widgets, and icons in silver, rose gold, bronze and graphite. Monthly, yearly with a one-week free trial, or lifetime with a single purchase. Everything you've recorded stays yours, always.
Perfect for
• Anyone who wants to know where the money goes
• Households with more than one account or currency
• Stock and crypto investors
• Freelancers and travelers
• People who value privacy
From the first expense to a full picture of your wealth, Moneys keeps the numbers honest and the experience quiet.
